title: International Registry for TRPM3-associated Disorders
summary: The goal of the TRPM3Care-registry is to record the disease progression of patients with TRPM3-associated disorders. This allows us to compare the disease progression and the success of different therapies, as well as to examine their impact on quality of life.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Variant in the TRPM3 gene

Exclusion Criteria:

* no consent from patient/familiy
